messages.subject: summary of lm model
parts:
Hi,

i m using renjin to process large models and i would like to get 'summary' of the model. my approach is:

            ListVector model;
          
                model = (ListVector)engine.eval("model1");
               
               
            Vector summary_values = model.getElementAsVector("summary");
            for(int i = 0; i < summary_values.length(); i++){
                System.out.println( this.thread_id + ": " + summary_values.getName(i) + ": " + summary_values.getElementAsDouble(i));
            }
 
but only get an error:

Exception in thread "Thread-0" java.lang.ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException: -1
    at org.renjin.sexp.ListVector.getElementAsSEXP(ListVector.java:151)
    at org.renjin.sexp.ListVector.getElementAsVector(ListVector.java:172)
    at aaa_full_process.all_process_thread.build_model(all_process_thread.java:1216)
    at aaa_full_process.all_process_thread.run(all_process_thread.java:173)

Please help. How can i get the values of the summary.

Thanks Georg

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: summary of lm model
parts:
It looks to me like the statement model.getElementAsVector("summary") is failing, probably because the model list has no element named 'summary'. 

Are you sure you want a list element named 'summary', and not the result of the summary() function?

Alex
